text: Vmoto is the brand of Vmoto Limited, a company listed on the Australian Securities Exchange as VMT.
short: Vmoto is the brand of Vmoto Limited, listed on the ASX (VMT).

source.name: Vmoto: Investor Centre
source.note: Vmoto's own Investor Centre shows its ASX listing (ASX:VMT) and its corporate-governance documents; the site footer names the operator 'Vmoto Limited' ('© 2026 Vmoto Limited').
